$comment: The seven, in tier order: villager 1 camps beside orb 1. Who they are, what they look like and what they say, all in one place — they used to be split across villagers.js and voice.js with a warning to keep the spellings in step across three files. `id` is the key into palette.js's VILLAGER table and supplies coat, hat and skin, so no colour is written here.
$writing: They are former seekers who never finished. Each camps beside the furthest orb they ever reached, which is why the one by orb 7 is so much harder than the one by orb 1 — their difficulty IS their story. Write each voice as somebody who got exactly that far and stopped.

villagers.name: Bram the Woodcutter
villagers.note: Never really tried. Warm about it.

voice.challenge: One orb. That is all I ever carried out of this valley. Let us see if your arms are better than mine were.
voice.theyWin: Ha! Still in me somewhere. Go on — the rest of them are worse than me.
voice.theyLose: Quick hands. I wish I had had them when it counted.

villagers.name: Nell the Herbalist
villagers.note: Found something she liked better than wishing.

voice.challenge: The second is mine. Not that I wanted the others — there are better things growing out here than wishes.
voice.theyWin: Patience beats hurry. Ask the moss, it has been here longer.
voice.theyLose: Off you go, then. Mind the nettles down by the water.

villagers.name: Pip the Courier
villagers.note: Rushed, broke the order, still insists it was fine.

voice.challenge: Third! Third, and I would have had the lot, only I grabbed them out of order like a fool. Come on, quickly.
voice.theyWin: Too slow! Everyone is always too slow.
voice.theyLose: Fine. You are quick. Do not be quick about the order, though. That is how you end up camped by the third.

villagers.name: Marla Stonehand
villagers.note: Got halfway on sheer strength. Says little.

voice.challenge: Four. Halfway, near enough. You will not rush me.
voice.theyWin: Hands like stone. I did say.

villagers.name: Old Tarrow
villagers.note: Has watched many seekers pass. Kind, and a little sad.

voice.challenge: The fifth. I have watched a great many people walk past me, and rather fewer walk back. Let us see which you are.
voice.theyWin: No shame in it. I have lost at this spot more times than you have stood on it.
voice.theyLose: Go on, then. And when it asks you — think before you speak.

villagers.name: Sable the Fencer
villagers.note: Failed at the sixth twice, and it still stings.

voice.challenge: Six. Twice I stood here, and twice I turned around. You will do no better.
voice.theyWin: As I thought. The sixth keeps its own.
voice.theyLose: Again? Then go. Go and see what is past it, and come back and tell me.

villagers.name: The Grey Pilgrim
villagers.note: Reached the seventh and chose not to wish. Barely speaks.

voice.challenge: I have been where you are going.
voice.theyWin: Then you are not ready. Good.
